verdict.rationale: The pack shows no native auto-reply, missed-call text-back, after-hours SMS reply, or scheduled-text feature. The closest item is a tutorial on using the Messages API endpoints to trigger SMS (aircall-docs-10), which is a developer building block rather than the capability itself. AI Agents handling after-hours calls and business-hours call routing cover voice, not texts, so they are adjacent features and earn no credit.
